arxiv-2105-13559.title: One-shot Learning with Absolute Generalization
arxiv-2105-13559.creator: 1 st Hao Su
arxiv-2105-13559.description: Abstract One-shot learning is proposed to make a pretrained classifier workable on a new dataset based on one labeled samples from each pattern. However, few of researchers consider whether the dataset itself supports one-shot learning. In this paper, we propose a set of definitions to explain what kind of datasets can support one-shot learning and propose the concept “absolute generalization”.

arxiv-2202-12637.title: Do autoencoders need a bottleneck for anomaly detection? Journal: -
arxiv-2202-12637.creator: Bang Xiang Yong, Alexandra Brintrup
arxiv-2202-12637.description: Abstract A common belief in designing deep autoencoders (AEs), a type of unsupervised neural network, is that a bottleneck is required to prevent learning the identity function. Learning the identity function renders the AEs useless for anomaly detection. In this work, we challenge this limiting belief and investigate the value of non-bottlenecked AEs.

arxiv-2203-15835.title: ACR Loss: Adaptive Coordinate-based Regression Loss for Face Alignment
arxiv-2203-15835.creator: Ali Pourramezan Fard, Mohammad H. Mahoor
arxiv-2203-15835.description: Abstract Although deep neural networks have achieved reasonable accuracy in solving face alignment, it is still a challenging task, specifically when we deal with facial images, under occlusion, or extreme head poses. Heatmap-based Regression (HBR) and Coordinate-based Regression (CBR) are among the two mainly used methods for face alignment.

arxiv-2206-07118.title: Unification of Perdew-Zunger Self-Interaction Correction, DFT+U, and Rung 3.5 Density Functionals
arxiv-2206-07118.creator: Benjamin G. Janesko
arxiv-2206-07118.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Benjamin G. Janesko. We unify the Perdew-Zunger self-interaction correction (PZSIC) to approximate density functional theory (DFT), the Hubbard correction DFT+U, and Rung 3.5 functionals within the Adiabatic Projection formalism. We modify the Kohn-Sham reference system, introducing electron self-interaction in selected states. Choosing those states as localized orbitals, localized atomic states, or states at each point in space recovers PZSIC, DFT+U, and Rung 3.5. Typical Hubbard U parameters approximate scaled-down PZSIC.

arxiv-2209-09270.title: Jetted narrow-line Seyfert 1 galaxies breaking the jet paradigm – a comprehensive study of host galaxy morphologies
arxiv-2209-09270.creator: I. Varglund, E. Järvelä, A. Lähteenmäki, M. Berton, S. Ciroi, E. Congiu
arxiv-2209-09270.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by I. Varglund, E. Järvelä, A. Lähteenmäki, M. Berton, S. Ciroi, E. Congiu. Narrow-line Seyfert 1 (NLS1) galaxies are unevolved active galactic nuclei (AGN) that exist predominantly in spiral galaxies. However, mostly due to the small number of sources studied, it has been under debate whether also the hosts of jetted NLS1 galaxies, a particular subclass of these sources hosting a relativistic jet, are disk-like, or elliptical, as the hosts of more powerful jetted AGN.

arxiv-2403-16872.creator: Geferson Lucatelli, Rob Beswick, Javier Moldon, Miguel Á. Pérez-Torres, J. E. Conway, Antxon Alberdi, Cristina Romero-Cañizales, Eskil Varenius, Hans-Rainer Klöckner, L. Barcos-Muñoz, Marco Bondi, Simon T. Garrington, Susanne Aalto, Willem A. Baan, Ylva M. Pihlstrom
arxiv-2403-16872.description: Abstract Disentangling the radio flux contribution from star formation (SF) and active-galactic-nuclei (AGN) activity is a long-standing problem in extragalactic astronomy, since at frequencies of ≲ \lesssim 10 GHz, both processes emit synchrotron radiation. We present in this work the general objectives of the PARADIGM Project, a multi-instrument concept to explore star-formation and mass assembly of galaxies.

arxiv-2505-07899.description: Abstract Sequential knowledge editing techniques aim to continuously update knowledge in large language models at low cost, preventing models from generating outdated or incorrect information. Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) is a pathologic condition of carbohydrate intolerance that begins or is first detected during pregnancy, making it one of the most common pregnancy complications.

pmc-11329640.title: Effects of physical training on coagulation parameters, interleukin-6, and angiotensin-converting enzyme-2 in COVID-19 survivors
pmc-11329640.creator: Soheila Binabaji, Mohammad Rahimi, Hamid Rajabi, Mohsen Keshavarz, Rahimeh Rahimi, Azam Ahmadi, Daniel Gahreman
pmc-11329640.description: COVID-19 is a highly contagious virus that uses Angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 (ACE2) as a receptor to enter human cells. The virus leads to an increase in inflammatory cytokines (i.e. IL-6) and an impaired coagulation system, which can cause serious complications during and after the disease.

pmc-11470593.title: Isolated aseptic loosening in total knee arthroplasty: a comprehensive 10-year review of partial vs. total component revisions
pmc-11470593.creator: Yu-Chih Lin, Sheng-Hsun Lee, Chih-Hsiang Chang, Yu-Kai Lin, Chih-Chien Hu, Sheng-Hsuan Lin
pmc-11470593.description: BackgroundIn total knee arthroplasty (TKA), isolated aseptic loosening (IAL) requires the replacement of prosthetic components, with ongoing debate regarding the effectiveness of partial component revision (PCR) compared to total component revision (TCR). This study aims to compare implant survival and surgical outcomes between PCR and TCR in the context of IAL.

pmc-11508874.title: New Approaches Based on Inflammatory Indexes in the Evaluation of the Neoplastic Potential of Colon Polyps
pmc-11508874.creator: Sedat Ciftel, Serpil Ciftel, Aleksandra Klisic, Filiz Mercantepe, Fabrizio Montecucco
pmc-11508874.description: Colorectal polyps, precursors to colorectal cancer (CRC), require precise identification for appropriate diagnosis and therapy. This study aims to investigate the differences in hematological and inflammatory markers, specifically the CALLY index, HALP score, and immuno-inflammatory indexes, between neoplastic and nonneoplastic polyps. A retrospective cross-sectional study was conducted on 758 patients aged 61.0 ± 11.

pmc-11672658.title: DNA Barcoding Reveals Species Diversity and Host Associations of Dryinidae Wasps (Insecta, Hymenoptera): A Case Study from the Xisha Islands in the South China Sea

pmc-11672658.description: Plain language summaryDryinidae are a diverse family of parasitoids, and they are important natural enemies of Auchenorrhyncha (Hemiptera) pests. A comprehensive understanding of the diversity and host interaction networks of these parasitoids is critical to their application in biological control programs and their conservation.

pmc-12471250.title: The VincerEmo Pilot Study: Prospective Analysis of Controlled Physical Activity in People with severe Hemophilia
pmc-12471250.creator: Federica Valeri, Cristina Dainese, Piera Merli, Mariella Galizia, Samuel Agostino, Nicolas Cunsolo, Carola Sella, Alessandra Valpreda, Mariagiulia Bailon, Marco Miniotti, Annamaria Porreca, Giuseppe Massazza, Benedetto Bruno, Alessandra Borchiellini, Michael B Nichol, Jonathan C Roberts
pmc-12471250.description: Background/Objectives: The approach to physical activity in people with hemophilia (PwH) is still conditioned by many difficulties. Thus, a prospective observational pilot study has been carried out aiming to evaluate how an adequate and controlled training program can slow down the onset or evolution of arthropathy and improve musculoskeletal health and quality of life.

pmc-12502923.title: Chronic expanding hematomas arising over a decade post primary total hip arthroplasty
pmc-12502923.creator: Chuanlong Wu, Hongyi Wang, Teng Yu, Qiyuan Bao, Junxiang Wen, Jiong Zhang, Zhihong Liu, Jianmin Feng, Weibin Zhang, Chuan He
pmc-12502923.description: BackgroundChronic expanding hematoma (CEH) is an infrequent yet serious complication following total hip arthroplasty (THA). Mismanagement of this condition can result in severe consequences. The purpose of this study is to conduct a retrospective analysis of patients who developed CEH after THA at our institution over the past 20 years, complemented by a review of the existing literature.

pmc-12781708.title: Systematic review and risk factor analysis of post-vitrectomy silicone oil migration to the central nervous system
pmc-12781708.creator: Lucy Wing Wong, Wai Yan Lam, Sunny Chi Lik Au
pmc-12781708.description: BACKGROUNDSilicone oil (SiO) migration to the central nervous system (CNS) is a rare complication of SiO tamponade after vitreo-retinal surgeries, it could masquerade hemorrhage on computed tomography neuro-imaging. Only limited cases were reported in the literature, certain intra-operative and post-operative ocular risk factors might contribute to the different extend of SiO migration in the CNS.

pmc-13234845.title: A naphthyl polymer with STING-activating property for antigen and adjuvant co-delivery to achieve potent cancer immunotherapy
pmc-13234845.creator: Lanfang Ren, Qianqian Chen, Yan Lou, Yang Chen, Chunyang Yuan, Yunfeng Liu, Jia Lv, Zhoufang Mei, Yiyun Cheng, Xiaopan Cai
pmc-13234845.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Therapeutic cancer vaccines remain constrained by insufficient intracellular antigen trafficking and weak activation of innate immunity. Here, we report an immunoactive dendrimer-based nanovaccine platform that integrates efficient antigen cytosolic transport with intrinsic stimulation of innate immunity. Through screening a library of thiourea-modified dendrimers, we identify a naphthyl-functionalized polymer (D15) that forms stable antigen nanocomplexes via noncovalent interactions, enabling rapid endosomal escape and efficient cytosolic antigen release in dendritic cells.

pmc-13549053.title: Coupled Fe3O4‐Cluster Precipitates and Single Fe‐Atom Catalysts Can Boost Oxygen Reduction via Concomitantly Accelerated Water Dissociation
pmc-13549053.creator: Cheng‐Kai Du, Xiongyi Liang, Fei‐Xiang Ma, Yutong Li, Zheng‐Qi Liu, Long Ma, Zeng Li, Liang Zhen, Yan Huang, Xiao Cheng Zeng, Cheng‐Yan Xu
pmc-13549053.description: Fe–N–C single‐atom catalysts (SACs) can deliver high activity for catalyzing the oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) in alkaline conditions. However, the sluggish water dissociation upon Fe–N4 active sites limits their proton‐coupled electron transfer (PCET) capability, impeding their practical applications like anion‐exchange membrane fuel cells (AEMFCs).

pmc-13556084.title: Paediatric trauma mortality at a level 1 trauma centre: a retrospective case series at Karolinska University Hospital, Stockholm
pmc-13556084.creator: Ammar Yaqoob, Shahzad Akram
pmc-13556084.description: Paediatric trauma mortality is uncommon in well-resourced systems, limiting clinical exposure and necessitating system-level learning through detailed review of individual deaths. This retrospective descriptive case series characterises paediatric trauma deaths following trauma-call activation at Karolinska University Hospital (KUH), Stockholm, Sweden’s primary level 1 trauma centre, between 2016 and 2025.

pmc-13676182.title: Supporting Social Engagement in Long-Term Care Through Paired Socially Assistive Robot-Virtual Reality Activities for Older Adults with Cognitive Impairment and Apathy
pmc-13676182.creator: Miroslava Migovich, Ritam Ghosh, Nibraas Khan, Cathy A Maxwell, Paul A Newhouse, Douglas W Scharre, Alai Tan, Judith A Tate, Lorraine C Mion, Nilanjan Sarkar
pmc-13676182.description: IntroductionOlder adults living in long-term care settings, particularly those with cognitive impairment and apathy, frequently experience reduced social engagement. Socially assistive robots and virtual reality systems may help support engagement, but little is known about whether they can sustain engagement during real-world deployment while also facilitating interaction between older adults.
